confidence_notes: Restaurant and coffee anchors rest on several aggregator cost-of-living figures from 2025-2026 that broadly agree. Beer, cocktail and wine rest on older undated or 2015-2022 bar listings, so they are less certain. Meal and coffee figures were checked against search results only. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates and were not checked against any search or live listing. FX: the most recent RBA observation I could verify is 2026-03-20 (AUD/USD 0.7088, shown on the RBA exchange-rates page in search results). I could not verify any later RBA observation before the 2026-11-19 generation date. An aggregator figure for 2026-10-27 was unverified and not used.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional SEA basis for a mid-sized heritage tourist town in Cambodia, using Siem Reap cost-of-living guides for food and coffee, older bar listings for drinks, and model knowledge of Southeast Asian tourist-town accommodation tiers for lodging. Drinks were set by local price relationship to beer where direct evidence was weak.
